rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING CERTAIN MEASURES NECESSARY AND PROPER TO EFFECTIVELY AND DECISIVELY ADDRESS THE ENERGY SHORTAGE
rows.abstract: "Energy Crisis Act" States those laws that are declared SUSPENDED for a period of one (1) year from the effectivity of this Act. Imposes  a SURCHARGE ON POWER RATES at  the rate of 200% per kilowatt hour in excess of 500 kw  hours; empowers the President to reorganize the National Power Corporation.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08546
